title: Accelerating Retrieval-Augmented Generation
problem: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for LLMs suffer from high latency in the retrieval phase due to expensive nearest-neighbor search over large knowledge bases, and existing profiling of the interplay between retrieval accuracy and generation phase cost is lacking. The choice between exact and approximate retrieval is not well characterized in terms of end-to-end latency vs. accuracy.
motivation: RAG is a leading approach to reduce LLM hallucinations, but its retrieval bottleneck creates latency that undermines serving efficiency; counterintuitively, exact retrieval can reduce total end-to-end inference time by reducing the number of documents passed to the expensive generative model.
method: The paper profiles multiple RAG execution pipelines to characterize how retrieval time (finding documents) and generation time (creating answers) interact. It demonstrates that exact nearest-neighbor search—which finds the truly closest documents rather than using faster approximations—actually outperforms approximate retrieval end-to-end because it returns a smaller, higher-precision set of documents, reducing the inference burden on the language model's generation stage. The paper proposes hardware and system optimizations to accelerate exact nearest-neighbor search.
key_novelty: Exact nearest-neighbor retrieval—finding the truly closest document matches rather than approximations—reduces RAG's end-to-end latency compared to approximate retrieval because it feeds the generation model fewer, higher-quality documents, motivating hardware acceleration of exact search.
contributions: Profiling and characterization of multiple RAG execution pipelines exposing the retrieval-generation performance interplay.
Counterintuitive finding that exact retrieval can reduce end-to-end RAG latency versus approximate retrieval at equal accuracy.
Motivation and design of system/hardware acceleration for exact nearest-neighbor search in RAG workloads.
Analysis of accuracy-latency trade-offs across different retrieval strategies in production-scale RAG settings.

metrics.other: end-to-end RAG latency reduction; specific numbers not in abstract

limitations: The specific hardware acceleration mechanism for exact nearest-neighbor search is not detailed in the abstract.
primary_theme: hardware acceleration of exact retrieval for RAG pipelines
